blocks.html: Point at a spot on the map and everyone on your network sees it live, with range and bearing from you and optional threat rings.

slides.title: Drop a live pointer
slides.html: Tap the Digital Pointer icon, then Pointer to drop a marker on the map. Anyone on your network sees it appear and gets a notification, with a line running back to you.

slides.title: Show range, bearing and threat rings
slides.html: Tap your own pointer to open its radial menu. Pick Range and Bearing Line to show distance and direction from you, or Custom Threat Rings to add danger rings around the spot.

slides.title: Use a teammate's pointer
slides.html:
Tap someone else's pointer for extra options:

  • Lock to Self to keep it centred on your position
  • Bloodhound Tool to navigate to it
  • Track Breadcrumbs to follow its trail

slides.title: Point at an exact grid
slides.html: Tap GoTo MGRS on the Digital Pointer toolbar to type a 10-digit Easting and Northing by hand. The pointer drops on that exact grid for the current map view.
